name: The Dark Quarter
detailed_description:
This application is a digital companion for The Dark Quarter board game from Lucky Duck Games.

The Dark Quarter is a cooperative digital hybrid adventure game that tells a rich, dynamic story through a multi-scenario campaign. Players are invited to make critical decisions that will not only affect their characters but also change the course of the narrative itself. Characters are not simply avatars, easily replaceable from one scenario to the next; instead, they are woven into the very fabric of the story. Their destiny and the destiny of New Orleans are inextricably linked.

The game is a digital hybrid, mixing physical components with the app. Players move their miniatures around the map, roll dice to perform tests, and scan QR codes printed on cards to use items. The app guides the use of physical components, provides narration, and describes the results of the players’ actions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), 10, 11
  • Processor: 64 bit with SSE2
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable
  • Additional Notes: Requires Camera (to scan QR codes on physical cards)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 18.04
  • Processor: 64 bit with SSE2
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable
  • Additional Notes: Requires Camera (to scan QR codes on physical cards)

content_descriptors.notes: This game is intended for adults only. It contains mature themes, including strong language, sexual innuendo, depictions of alcohol, tobacco, and drug use, as well as scenes of violence and gore. While much of this content is delivered through narrative description, some visual elements—particularly those involving violence—are also present.
